text:
sam: quick ask — where can I find the autoscale decision timeline + logs for the dedicated pool `rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02`? trying to understand why we scaled up 3x yesterday at ~18:20 UTC, alerts went off but infra says we were under commit. :thinking:

nina: jump to the pool dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02 
it has: per-pool qps/latency, kvcache hit rate, inflight_reqs, and the autoscale event timeline (bottom panel). the autoscaler writes events to the `autoscale-events` index in ES/Kibana.

sam: perfect — any quick queries for Kibana to filter just that window?

nina: use this Kibana filter for the 18:10-18:30 window:
```
index: autoscale-events
pool: "rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02"
@timestamp: [2025-08-12T18:10:00 TO 2025-08-12T18:30:00]
```
also check logs from the router pods (label `svc=redwood-router, pool=rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02`) — they show request shapes that triggered burst policy.

charlie: fwiw the autoscaler can trigger on combined signals. the rule that fired was our default "sustained-inflight" which looks at a 2m p95 inflight above 85% of pool capacity. sometimes short KV-cache miss storms can spike inflight without CPU rising.

sam: where is that rule authored? I want to propose reducing sensitivity for pools with good kvcache.

charlie: rule is in infra/autoscale/policies/defaults.yaml in the infra repo. snippet:
```
- name: sustained-inflight
  window: 120s
  threshold: 0.85
  metric: pool_inflight_p95
  action: scale_up
```
open a tiny PR and tag me, we can backtest against the event archive.

maya: for testing, you can replay the autoscale snapshot from S3: s3://rwd-autoscale-archive/eu-west-2a/rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02/2025-08-12-18-20.json 
that contains metrics + decision inputs we can feed to the local evaluator.

sam: awesome. any recommended PromQL panels to add to the pool dashboard to reduce future false positives?

nina: add these two (Prometheus):
```
# inflight p95 per-pool
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(pool_request_latency_seconds_bucket{pool="rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02"}[2m])) by (le))

# kvcache miss rate
sum(rate(kvcache_request_total{pool="rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02", result="miss"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(kvcache_request_total{pool="rwd-ded-eu-west-2a-02"}[5m]))
```
Show kvcache miss alongside inflight; if miss >> baseline, suppress sustained-inflight alerts or raise threshold.

autoscale-bot: [system] recorded autoscale event 2025-08-12T18:20:43Z -> scale_up x3 (policy=sustained-inflight) (link: https://logs.redwood.internal/autoscale/1979991111/event/20250812-182043)

sam: thanks — will draft PR to lower sensitivity for pools where `kvcache_miss_rate < 0.05` and add the two panels. charlie, pinging you for review.

charlie: :+1: sounds good. please include unit tests and a retest run against the archived snapshot. I can help replay it.

maya: also add an alert tweak: only fire sustained-inflight if kvcache_miss_rate < 0.1 OR cpu_util > 0.6. that'll reduce noise for transient cache storms.

sam: makes sense. I'll open PR with changes + dashboard JSON and link the run results here. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:

nina: if you want a quick panel template, ping me and I can paste it.

sam: will do, thanks everyone. closing the loop once PR lands. :white_check_mark:
